name: Qualia, Great Barrier Reef
positioning: Pavilion resort for guests 16 and over on the northern tip of Hamilton Island, set in bushland above the Coral Sea and the Whitsundays
best_for: Couples who want a pavilion with its own plunge pool and sea views
Travelers who want easy access to the Great Barrier Reef, Heart Reef and Whitehaven Beach

facts.text: qualia is on the northernmost part of Hamilton Island, surrounded by the Great Barrier Reef, with views across the Coral Sea and the Whitsundays.
The pavilions are surrounded by native bushland and overlook the Coral Sea.
Pavilions have louvre windows, polished hardwood floors and warm timber details, giving them an Australian beach house feel.
Leeward Pavilions face south-west, looking across Dent Passage and the Whitsundays and catching the afternoon light and island sunsets.
The Beach House has its own infinity-edge pool and a separate guest house for friends or family.
The Residence is the largest property at qualia and has a private infinity-edge lap pool.
Spa qualia sits at the heart of the resort and offers facials, massage, yoga and holistic therapies.
Spa qualia uses the Australian ranges Sodashi, LaGaia Unedited and People4Ocean.
qualia has its own private helipad.
Stays include use of non-motorised watercraft, including snorkelling equipment, stand-up paddleboards, kayaks, pedal boards and catamarans.
Guests have an electric golf buggy for their own use around qualia or Hamilton Island.
qualia has two restaurants: Long Pavilion, set high among Eucalyptus trees, and Pebble Beach, on the edge of the sand.

highlights.text: Windward Pavilions face north-east, each with a private infinity-edge plunge pool and 180-degree views across the Whitsundays and the Coral Sea.
Guests can take a private helicopter tour to Heart Reef.
Guests can cruise on qualia's private charter boat or go across to Whitehaven Beach with a gourmet picnic.
Spa qualia has private Roman bath suites for couples.

considerations.text: qualia is exclusively for guests aged 16 and over.
Pre-booking is required for dining, spa treatments, golf and other tours and activities.
